aboutHeading: I help clients turn cold markets into warm pipelines
aboutText: Talent brings results, but a strong pipeline brings consistency. I'm Pawan Soni, and for eight years I've helped real estate clients solve the unpredictable lead cycle and build calendars that stay reliably full. I started in a brokerage back office, watched clients burn out chasing unqualified leads, and decided there had to be a better way. Today I build lead generation systems exclusively for real estate — combining targeted advertising, smart nurturing, and relentless optimization so the right prospects come to you.
